purpose: Bind Gothic railing post taxonomy names to source-owned geometric shaping ledgers and Blender tool sequences before any recipe or adapter generates mesh.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Gothic Architecture
sources.support_summary: Supports pointed arches, rib vaulting, tracery, vertical emphasis, and buttress vocabulary used as morphology references.

sources.title: Royal Institute of British Architects: Gothic Architecture
sources.support_summary: Supports Gothic elements such as pointed arches, ribbed vaults, flying buttresses, and decorative stone detail.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Foil
sources.support_summary: Supports trefoil, quatrefoil, and cinquefoil vocabulary as lobed Gothic and tracery shapes.

sources.title: The National Gallery: Quatrefoils
sources.support_summary: Supports quatrefoil as four-lobed ornament vocabulary.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Newel
sources.support_summary: Supports newel as the large post at the foot, landing, or turn of a staircase.

sources.title: User-Supplied Compound Pier Reference
sources.support_summary: Supports clustered shafts, lobed cross sections, capitals, and arch-to-pier transitions for Gothic post thinking.

sources.title: User-Supplied Gothic Railing and Pattern References
sources.support_summary: Supports translating dense 2D pattern work into selected ribs, tracery, post faces, and repeated ornamental modules.

style_sheets.style_intent: A square post that reads like a miniature buttress: chamfered plinth, vertical face strips, rail sockets, blind pointed-arch panels, and a stepped cap.

geometric_shaping_ledger.role: stable base mass with softened corners

source_shapes.control_policy: width and depth set the base footprint
chamfer amount converts square to low octagon

construction_rules: base footprint remains square-reading
corner bevels are smaller than one sixth of footprint

blender_tool_sequence.use: Create the primary plinth block.
Chamfer exposed plinth edges and corners.
Keep the low-poly stone faces clean after beveling.

geometric_shaping_ledger.role: vertical support with four shallow buttress-like raised strips

source_shapes.control_policy: height and side width set the straight post body
strip taper and offset make the face read like a buttress

construction_rules: face strips repeat on all four sides
raised strips stop below cap collar

blender_tool_sequence.use: Create the square shaft core and raised face strip meshes.
Place matching buttress strips on four sides.
Chamfer strip edges for catch lights.
Preserve the main arrises.

source_shapes.control_policy: span, springline, apex, and border thickness define the arch
inset rectangle provides readable shadow field

construction_rules: arch recess is decorative only
profile is mirrored to paired faces when used on side views

blender_tool_sequence.use: Create deterministic pointed-arch cutter or raised rim mesh.
Cut a shallow blind arch recess into selected post faces.
Mirror paired panels across the post centerlines.
Round the arch rim enough to catch light.

style_sheets.style_intent: A post built like a simplified compound pier: central mass, repeated attached ribs, ring collars, and a square-to-round-to-square transition.

geometric_shaping_ledger.role: compound-pier-like vertical body with low-poly attached ribs

source_shapes.control_policy: low segment count sets cylindrical core
rib radius and count set clustered silhouette

construction_rules: ribs are separate named parts before optional join
entasis can taper section radius from base to cap

blender_tool_sequence.use: Create low-segment center shaft volumes.
Create custom rib cross-section meshes when profile ribs are not circular.
Repeat attached ribs around the shaft.
Smooth the round-reading faces while retaining silhouette controls.
Clean up shading across joined rib/core surfaces.

geometric_shaping_ledger.role: ring stack that clamps shaft transitions

source_shapes.control_policy: radius sets collar projection
height and projection set crisp separating bands

construction_rules: collars appear at base and below capital
ring heights are independent edit knobs

blender_tool_sequence.use: Create round-reading bead or torus collars.
Revolve a stepped molding profile when the collar needs cove/torus layers.
Join collar rings into the post module after part naming is captured.
Add crisp edges to flat fillet bands.

style_sheets.style_intent: A clean square newel whose faces carry selectable blind tracery: pointed arch, quatrefoil, rosette, and bead-strip layers.

geometric_shaping_ledger.role: flat field that receives selected linework or raised ornament

source_shapes.control_policy: field inset, border width, and depth set shadow layer
corner radius can soften a face recess without changing the box post

construction_rules: recess exists on all four sides unless side mask omits faces
panel field never cuts through the post core

blender_tool_sequence.use: Create the post box core and flat panel fields.
Create shallow recesses without cutting through the post.
Repeat the face fields on all four sides.
Add readable lips around each panel field.

geometric_shaping_ledger.role: selectable lobed ornament on the face field

source_shapes.control_policy: lobe radius and offset define trefoil/quatrefoil/cinquefoil variants
point count and inner radius define sharp rosette alternatives

construction_rules: motif is a raised or recessed layer selected from the same center point
foil count remains an edit knob instead of separate scripts

blender_tool_sequence.use: Create low-poly foil or rosette profile geometry.
Place lobes around the motif center.
Give linework or foil profiles a controlled thickness.
Round small motif edges for visible highlights.

style_sheets.style_intent: A vertical Gothic post that terminates in a small spire or pyramidal pinnacle and keeps rail sockets clearly named.

geometric_shaping_ledger.role: explicit rail connector pockets that later recipes can fit rails into

source_shapes.control_policy: width, height, and depth match rail connector envelope
corner radius prevents a raw rectangular cut when desired

construction_rules: socket dimensions are source-owned
opposite sockets mirror around the post centerline

blender_tool_sequence.use: Create deterministic socket cutters.
Cut rail pockets into selected post faces.
Mirror the pocket to the opposite face.
Chamfer the socket rim.

source_shapes.control_policy: base width and height control steepness
octagonal base transitions from square cap into spire

construction_rules: spire remains optional and detachable
spire base footprint stays inside cap footprint

blender_tool_sequence.use: Create low-poly pyramidal or conic spire geometry.
Create stepped cap blocks below the pinnacle.
Join cap and spire after naming separate parts.
Keep the spire faceted instead of over-smoothed.
Add tiny bevels to avoid razor edges.

style_sheets.style_intent: A more ornamental post variant where small repeated protrusions climb the finial or cap edges while the core post remains simple.

geometric_shaping_ledger.role: repeated small leaf-like or tooth-like edge protrusions on a cap or finial

source_shapes.control_policy: height, projection, and pitch define a readable low-cost protrusion
rounded low-poly capsule can replace triangular teeth

construction_rules: crockets are optional named ornaments
array count and spacing are source parameters
ornament never changes socket placement

blender_tool_sequence.use: Create one low-poly crocket piece from source profile points.
Repeat crocket pieces along cap or finial edges.
Wrap crocket arrays around four post sides or radial finials.
Soften tiny protrusion edges.
Keep the small repeated pieces from shading noisily.

geometric_shaping_ledger.role: shared export readiness checks for any post style generated from this sheet

source_shapes.control_policy: post parts must fit declared post envelope

construction_rules: all visible pieces must keep stable part names
generated mesh must stay inside declared asset bounds

blender_tool_sequence.use: Assign a basic deterministic UV layout after geometry is compiled.
Assign a plain source-selected preview material.
Measure post bounds after assembly.
Check mesh validity before preview or export.
Preview only after deterministic geometry exists.
Export only after validation passes.
